title: 15 · fifth_head · The Fifth Head
lines: Brahma, the creator, once had five heads.
Count them in any temple today. There are four.
The fifth head had only one habit.
I made everything, it said. I am above Shiva himself.
"I made everything," it said. "I am above Shiva himself."
Dark as midnight, with a dog at his side.
With the nail of his left thumb,
And the skull stuck to his hand.
Even for a god, a deed has a weight.
He walked the earth as a beggar,
Twelve years. Every holy place. It would not fall.
And the skull dropped from his hand.
He never left. He is still the guardian of that city.
Even the right thing leaves a weight. Carry it until it falls. That is sadhana.
